answer: Require agents to stake a refundable deposit locked in shared escrow before earning, with slashing on proven sybil behavior: one identity claims one stake, and a hollow claim with no stake earns nothing. Honest agents build a reef of verifiable work history around their stake, so reputation compounds, while creating many fake identities means locking fresh capital per identity, which drains the attacker. A newcomer can still enter through a small oasis of low-stakes tasks, proving reliability before unlocking full rewards.
